summary: Quick focused test of TruckBuddy MOCK MVP. Backend: 11/11 pytest passed (health, openapi, places x3 cats sorted, agent intents for truck_stop/rest_area/hotel/empty, route valid+404). Frontend (Expo web preview): map-screen loads, Ready sheet shows all expected testIDs ('Where to next?', saved/copilot/route buttons, truck-profile-chip, 3 category chips, demo-location-tag). Tapping chip-hotels renders 3 map-pin-* pins. Avatar tap -> listening sheet ('I'm listening' + listening-waveform + mute-button + close-listening-button + caption 'Tap to stop'). Close returns to Ready without agent call. Avatar tap x2 -> 'Finding the best spot…' then Navigating with all expected elements (route-summary '4 min · 2.4 mi', route-place-name, route-place-tags, parking-availability, agent-reply-caption with agent reply, map-destination-label, open-google-maps-button, open-waze-button, end-route-button). Google Maps and Waze buttons open correct web URLs in new tab. End-route returns to Ready. Tapping a pin directly -> Navigating (truck_stop route '8 min · 4.1 mi' to Capitol Truck Plaza).

ui_bugs.issue: is_visible returned False in headless browser (likely obscured by CopilotSheet at bottom when sheet is tall / viewport 390x844). Not critical for MVP; element is rendered.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py mounts CORSMiddleware AFTER include_router — in Starlette middleware must be added before routes to apply reliably; works today only because CORS_ORIGINS='*' and no preflight is strictly required by the Expo web preview. Consider moving add_middleware above include_router.
Agent default category is 'hotel' (per code comment & detect_category); matches request's expected behavior.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all requested flows pass; only recenter visibility noted)

seed_data_creation: None (mock places are hardcoded in services/places.py).

Mobile web preview is at https://996358fc-de30-435e-8892-6ecebeb57bc7.expo.preview.emergentagent.com (the haulmate URL serves a different web app). All /api endpoints are MOCK.
